result.one_liner: Gladly is a cloud-based customer support and helpdesk platform for managing customer interactions across multiple channels.

evidence.quote: token-based Basic Authentication. API tokens are associated with designated Gladly users.
Gladly does not offer a free plan, and free trials are not publicly available.
Gladly pricing typically starts at $180 to $210 per agent per month

result.notes: API requires a paid subscription starting at $180-210/agent/month with annual contracts. No free tier or public trial available. REST API is documented but access is gated behind paid plans. Authentication uses API tokens with Basic Authentication scheme.
